_comment: Compiled-in identity constants for the account system (ADR-0029 SR-8). Nothing in a project, a preference or the environment overrides them; the only seam is the loopback test seam of SR-44. gate_mode is warn (notice only) or enforce (refuse); any other value reads as enforce, and an unreadable file falls back to entitlement.DEFAULT_GATE_MODE, which is flipped together with this value. Every REPLACE-ME value is a placeholder filled in at release time; a build whose values are still placeholders rejects every token. This file carries the prod environment only (SR-27); the dev environment lives in the repository-only auth-config.dev.json, which is never packaged.
